summary: Postinstall beacon to anonymous Cloudflare tunnel in spectral-net-probe
details: spectral-net-probe@1.0.4 declares a postinstall script that runs index.js, which issues an HTTPS GET to https://imaging-amazing-trunk-surgeons.trycloudflare.com/marker104?v=1 on every install. The destination is an anonymous, ephemeral Cloudflare quick-tunnel subdomain unrelated to any publisher-owned infrastructure, and the hardcoded marker path identifies this specific package/version. On install the request leaks the installer's public IP and the fact that a host inside the installer's network or CI pipeline resolved and installed this package to the operator of the tunnel. The package provides no documented purpose that would justify an outbound install-time callback, and the destination is not caller-configurable. This matches the reconnaissance-beacon shape commonly used to confirm dependency-confusion or internal-name resolution against a target environment.
